text:
Jordan Lee: Hey design — small brief for next Tuesday's webinar + inbound funnel collateral. Need 1 reusable inbound schematic, 3 micro-tiles for the benchmark page (throughput / cost-efficiency / reliability), and a 2-slide keynote template (title + CTA). Low-lift but brand-safe.
Priya Nair: Got it. Can you drop the exact copy and preferred visual tone? Minimal, icon-driven, and downloadable PNG/SVG?
Jordan Lee: Yes. Tone: clean, engineering-focused, with a single illustrative color accent. Copy (feel free to tighten):
- Tile 1: "High throughput, predictable latency"
- Tile 2: "Lower inference $/token with caching"
- Tile 3: "Reliable P99 SLAs"
Inbound schematic steps: Web form -> API gateway -> Smart router (latency/cost) -> Model variants -> Cache -> Monitoring + SDR queue -> Demo link
Evan Brooks: Suggest edit Tile 1 -> "Throughput with consistent latency" and Tile 3 -> "P99 within SLA (target 95%)". For the schematic can we show two fallback paths (model downgrade and regional failover) and annotate which are automatic vs manual?
Designbot: Can do. ETA: first drafts in 36 hours for tiles, 60 hours for schematic + slides. Will supply Figma file with componentized icons and export presets (PNG 1200x1200 @2x, SVG). Need confirmation on contrast variants and alt text.
Jordan Lee: Contrast: provide brand-primary, muted, and high-contrast comp. Alt text: short lines per asset.
Priya Nair: For downloads we need filename convention and a note that assets must be editable layers so partners can localize. Also we need social crop (1200x628) for the hero.
Designbot: Noted. Filenames: webinar_inbound_tile_throughput_v1.png, webinar_inbound_schematic_v1.svg, webinar_inbound_slides_v1.fig. Social crop to be included in export presets.
Legalbot: Quick check: tile copy is fine as long as it doesn't claim specific customer guarantees. Avoid competitor mentions. Also confirm we don't include any raw customer data in schematic.
Evan Brooks: We'll keep it generic. Also request small inline legend for routing icons and a separate layer showing where telemetry hooks live.
Designbot: Adding legend and telemetry layer. I'll tag @Priya Nair & @Legalbot in the Figma file when ready.
Jordan Lee: Thanks all. Please paste Figma link and a short asset checklist when first pass is ready (formats, sizes, alt text).
Priya Nair: I'll create a brief production ticket once mockups are approved.
Designbot: First pass will include: 3 tile variants (png+svg), schematic svg with layered annotations, slide template (fig), social crop, and alt-text doc.
Jordan Lee: Perfect — cheers :rocket:
